j1_j2_sast_transposition_audit.finding: In `ch08_methodological_validation.json`, NOAA-20 (J1) daytime median UTC is 11.53h (13:32 SAST) and NOAA-21 (J2) daytime median UTC is 11.20h (13:12 SAST). However, the narrative summary table transposed these two values (listing J1 as 13:12 SAST and J2 as 13:32 SAST). Furthermore, SAST = UTC+2 is only a fixed meridian proxy (30 deg E), whereas Southern Africa detections span 11.67 deg E to 50.28 deg E (~2.57 hours of local solar time). True Local Solar Time (LST = UTC + lon/15) shows median daytime overpass at 13:55 LST (Aqua), 13:52 LST (J1), 13:31 LST (J2), and 10:33 LST (Terra).

1_M4_dimensional_and_threshold_flaw.code_vs_docstring_threshold_mismatch: Docstring stated scan > 2.5 km (MODIS) and > 0.65 km (VIIRS), but line 198 implemented max_scan = 2.2 (MODIS) and 0.60 (VIIRS).
1_M4_dimensional_and_threshold_flaw.explanation: Summing per-pixel FRP density `sum_i (FRP_i / A_i)` across unclustered detections is physically and dimensionally invalid: when a single fire of radiative power F is split across k sub-pixels each of area A_pixel, the sum of per-pixel densities equals `(sum FRP_i) / A_pixel = F / A_pixel`, which scales inversely with pixel area! Because VIIRS 375 m pixels have median area 0.1960 km^2 (mean 1/A = 5.1542 km^-2) while MODIS 1 km pixels have median area 1.1978 km^2 (mean 1/A = 0.7775 km^-2), dividing each pixel's FRP by its pixel area multiplies VIIRS FRP by 6.629x relative to MODIS! That directly explains why the J1/MODIS ratio jumped from 2.018x (M3 raw FRP) to 17.008x (M4) (`2.392x nadir FRP ratio * 6.629x inverse-area factor ≈ 15.86x`, plus scan-angle weighting). When corrected to nadir-filtered total FRP (`M4_corrected_nadir_filtered_total_frp_mw`), the J1/MODIS ratio is 2.392x, daily Spearman rho (MODIS vs J1) is 0.7857, and J1 vs J2 daily rho stays at 0.7500 instead of collapsing to 0.4643.

2_spatial_spearman_tie_breaking_bug_in_s.explanation: In `validate_ch08_adjustments_and_distinctions.py` lines 209-214, `spearman_corr` was implemented as `np.argsort(np.argsort(a))`, which assigns arbitrary sequential ranks (0, 1, 2, ...) to tied zero cells sorted by their index order instead of average ranks (`scipy.stats.spearmanr`). Because 316 of the 697 active 1x1 deg cells have 0 MODIS detections, `np.argsort(np.argsort(a))` assigned distinct sequential ranks to tied zero cells instead of average ranks. Under exact tie-corrected `scipy.stats.spearmanr`, spatial 1x1 deg correlation is 0.8435 (M1), 0.8323 (M2), 0.8324 (M3), and 0.8166 (M4) (vs 0.8314, 0.8182, 0.8156, and 0.8028 in Stream B).

3_j1_j2_complementary_swath_hypothesis.explanation: Because NOAA-20 (J1) and NOAA-21 (J2) fly in the same orbital plane separated by ~50 minutes (half-orbit), their ground tracks over Southern Africa on the same day are shifted in longitude by ~12.5 degrees (~1,250 km). Consequently, when a fire region is near the sub-satellite nadir of J1 (small scan angle, fine 0.14 km^2 pixels, high multi-pixel count), it lies near the outer swath edge of J2 (large scan angle, coarser pixels, bow-tie deletion), and vice versa. Across the 2,008 co-observed (cell, day) pairs, the correlation between J1 mean scan and J2 mean scan is negative (r = -0.3320), confirming the physical complementary swath geometry that causes J1 and J2 daily raw counts to correlate at rho = 0.6786 (M1) before improving to rho = 0.7500 under 0.02-deg grid clustering (M2) and rho = 0.9643 under true 1.0-3.0 km geodesic connected-component clustering.

stream_A_adversarial_methodological_find.1_ptops_raw_vs_agg_consensus_bug_in_fire: In `fire_convergence.py` line 216, `ptops` (individual platform top days used to compute `consensus_top` and `no_sensor_consensus`) was hardcoded to use `DATA[window][p][region][filt]['raw']` even when `agg` was `opp_norm`, `area`, or `cell_0p1`! Consequently, in Table 4.1 of `RUN005_CONVERGENCE.md`, `No consensus` was reported as a constant `7/16` across all 10 aggregations in 2026 and `11/16` in 2022. When corrected so each platform's singleton top day uses the active aggregation (`tops[(p,)]`), `no_sensor_consensus` in 2026 varies from 6/16 (`cell_0p5`) to 10/16 (`opp_norm`), and in 2022 from 9/16 (`opp_norm`) to 13/16 (`cell_0p1`, `cell_0p25`). Crucially, `sensor_set_sensitive` (148/160 in 2026, 160/160 in 2022) and `pivotal_rate` (I_p) used `tops[s]` directly and are 100% unaffected by this bug.
stream_A_adversarial_methodological_find.2_grid_origin_shift_and_equal_area_robus: Shifting the cell grid origin by half a cell (s/2) or applying a cos(lat) equal-area longitude scaling preserves high constellation sensitivity across all 5 spatial scales (13/16 to 16/16 in 2026; 15/16 to 16/16 in 2022), confirming that cell-day sensitivity is not a grid-alignment artifact.
stream_A_adversarial_methodological_find.3_opp_norm_bin_width_and_pooling_formula: Changing observed-overpass bin width from 30 min (15/16 sensitive) to 15 min gives 15/16 sensitive and 60 min gives 15/16 sensitive in 2026 (all 16/16 in 2022). Replacing the pooled ratio `sum(raw_p)/sum(opp_p)` with the equal-platform mean of ratios `mean(raw_p / opp_p)` gives 15/16 sensitive in 2026 and 16/16 in 2022, but shifts pivotal influence toward Terra and Aqua (just like total_norm).

platform_influence_v06.formula: I_p = #{S : p in S, |S| > 1, top(S) != top(S \ {p})} / #{S : p in S, |S| > 1}

mandatory_corrections.title: Falsified M4 Removed -> Validated M4c (NADIR_FILTERED_TOTAL_FRP) Implemented
mandatory_corrections.falsified_result: Inflated VIIRS by 6.629x (J1/MODIS = 17.008x) and collapsed J1-J2 daily Spearman rho from 0.8929 to 0.4643.
mandatory_corrections.validated_replacement: M4c = sum(FRP_i) where scan_i <= 1.3 * nadir (MODIS <= 1.30 km, VIIRS <= 0.49 km).

mandatory_corrections.title: 1 km Haversine Geodesic Connected Components (M2c: SPATIAL_DETECTION_CLUSTER_COUNT)
mandatory_corrections.falsified_method: Legacy M2 = 0.02-deg coordinate rounding (splits fire fronts across arbitrary grid lines).
mandatory_corrections.validated_replacement: M2c = 1.0 km Haversine great-circle connected-component graph clustering.
mandatory_corrections.validated_result: Reduces J1/MODIS ratio from 5.293x to 4.235x; raises J1-J2 Spearman rho from 0.7500 to 0.9643 and MODIS-J2 rho from 0.2857 to 0.6786.
